text: The 50/30/20 budget framework divides net income into 50% needs, 30% wants, and 20% savings.
Setting up automated bank transfers on payday helps ensure saving occurs before discretionary spending.
Emergency funds are typically sized at 3 to 6 months of essential living expenses.
A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) allows fixed periodical investments into mutual funds.
Index funds track a market benchmark like the Nifty 50 to offer broad market diversification.
Compound growth earns returns on both initial principal and previously accumulated gains.
Paying total credit balances in full every billing cycle avoids revolving interest charges.
CIBIL credit scores range from 300 to 900, with scores above 750 considered favorable by lenders.
Prioritizing high-interest debt payoff minimizes total interest expense over time.
Public Provident Fund (PPF) is a 15-year government-backed long-term savings scheme in India.
Unified Payments Interface (UPI) enables instant bank-to-bank transfers across India.
Settling group balances promptly helps maintain trust and financial transparency among peers.
Equal and exact expense splitting methods provide clarity on shared group liabilities.
Diversification across asset classes helps mitigate volatility in an investment portfolio.
